statements: VC-27.7: "every ManagementApiClient endpoint shares one Result contract - NetworkError on transport failure, ApiError(body,status) on non-2xx ... health_check (:586-597) is the one exception"
reason: The poll now joins three calls, including the new get_chain_payments, rather than two. ProcessAgentStatuses now also carries a dids map, and a ProcessChainPayments message is sent after it. The new get_chain_payments returns Ok(None) on a 404, so the claim that all endpoints except health_check share one error contract no longer holds.
